definition: Uncomfortable or harsh to live in or stay in.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: When I thought of the heavy rains and looked at the gaping roof I understood how strong and immutable must be the purpose which had kept him in that inhospitable abode.
example_sentence: The moors can be inhospitable in winter.
